caseNameFull: Califano, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v. Aznavorian and Aznavorian v. Califano, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. S. D. Cal. Motions of Grace Aznavorian for leave to proceed m forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
